messages:
Maria: hey team — opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/service/pull/5389 to change how tenant secrets are provisioned for onprem/VPC deploys. needs privacy/security signoff before i can merge. main changes: new per-tenant KMS key, reduce shared-secret usage, and a small egress allowlist for metrics shipping.

Liam: pinging security — this is for the client pilot next week. PR is small but touches auth token handshake. aim to merge by EOD thurs if safe.

Alex: @Maria thanks — quick q: are we using customer-managed KMS or our platform key? also need to confirm there is no plaintext caching in the sidecar. :eyes:

Maria: using platform KMS for now (we discussed customer KMS later), and i added a note in the PR about zero plaintext writes to disk. i ran the local smoke and redisiv cache looks ok.

sec-bot: Policy scan completed: 2 warnings, 0 fails. Warnings: "broad-iam-role-on-service-account" and "unspecified-egress-hosts". Details: https://ci.redwood/policy/scan/5389

Alex: ok on the scan — can you scope the SA down to just secrets.get and kms.encrypt for the sidecar? if you drop iam:*
then i can approve. also add an explicit egress CIDR list in the manifest rather than wildcard.

Liam: i can do the SA change, should be a 1-line tweak in helm chart. will push a commit in a few.

Sara: heads up — customer pilot is scheduled tues morning PT. we need the change in staging by monday night for a runbook + smoke. is that feasible?

Maria: timeline is tight but doable if we get security ok today. otherwise we push pilot by 48h.

Ops Oncall: deployment blackout Thurs 2200-0400 UTC for infra upgrades. if you plan EOD thurs merge, please avoid that window or coordinate with infra.

Liam: noted — aiming to merge by 19:00 UTC to avoid blackout.

Maria: pushed sa-scope fix and explicit egress CIDR (commit f3a2c1). removed iam:* references. updated PR description with test steps.

sec-bot: Re-scan: 0 warnings, 0 fails.

Alex: reviewed the changes. left one tiny nit on the helm values but not blocking. overall lgtm on security posture. :thumbsup:

Maria: thanks alex — addressing helm nit now, will squash and request merge slot.

Sara: perfect — once merged can we get a staging rollout doc in the PR description? quick checklist: deploy, smoke test, metrics sanity, rollback steps.

Maria: will add checklist and ping ops after merge. thanks all. :pray:
